headlines.title: Union Pacific Corporation: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: A proposed Norfolk Southern merger could reshape how freight moves across America, eliminating handoffs that slow shipments.

headlines.title: How Earnings Beat At Union Pacific Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: Union Pacific reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$7.2b and net income of US$2.1b, with diluted EPS from continuing operations of US$3.49, and affirmed high single digit reported EPS growth guidance for 2026. Freight and intermodal volume strength, together with higher fuel surcharge income and confirmed US$3.5b 2026 capital plans, underline how Union Pacific is relying on network efficiency and diesel fuel economics rather than financial engineering to support earnings.

headlines.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Stock Slips Even As Q3 Earnings Power Impresses
headlines.summary: Union Pacific stock slipped 1.8% to about US$292.80 on Friday, giving holders a mild post earnings bruise despite a very strong third quarter. The railroad just posted Q3 2026 revenue of US$7.2b and net income of about US$2.1b, with earnings per share running comfortably above US$3.50. Traders focused on the red number on the screen.

headlines.title: CFOs On the Move: Week ending Oct. 23
headlines.summary: Union Pacific’s CFO to retire after 35 years, Mach Industries appoints former GM exec as CFO and Pittsburgh Penguins hire a longtime Washington Nationals exec as CFO.

headlines.title: Union Pacific’s Dividend After Earnings: What the Numbers Say for Income Investors
headlines.summary: Union Pacific just beat earnings and raised its dividend for the 20th straight year, but a looming merger is redirecting billions away from shareholders. Here is what income investors need to know before the deal closes in 2027.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
